## MemoryFeed v0.3.1 — Real-world Extractor Validation

### Goal

Validate v0.3.0 extractor reliability against real saved DOM samples and improve debug visibility.

### Tasks

- [ ] Add saved HTML fixtures for Facebook, X/Twitter, YouTube, LinkedIn, TikTok.
- [ ] Add extractor confidence score.
- [ ] Add capture debug panel in extension popup.
- [ ] Show latest capture attempt status per platform.
- [ ] Add duplicate inspection/debug endpoint.
- [ ] Improve media URL normalization.
- [ ] Add regression tests for real-world fixture samples.

### Acceptance Criteria

- Each platform has at least 3 real-world DOM fixtures.
- Debug panel shows selector used, missing fields, and quality flags.
- Duplicate decisions can be inspected.
- Existing privacy/offline behavior remains unchanged.
